slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Freely
Freely You gave me eternal life
Life so indestructible
Freely
Freely You gave me Your righteousness
To live for You in liberty

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: If I could afford to pay
For everything You gave to me
It’d still be with all the wealth
You gave me freely

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: If I were to estimate or quantify
The value of Your love
It’d still be with all the wisdom
You gave me

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Father of love You truly are
You made the sun shine on all creation
Father Your love is unreserved
Freely You blessed me beyond imagination

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Freely
Freely You gave me unhindered access
To stand before Your presence
Freely
Freely You gave me the Holy Spirit

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: That’s how come I know about the things
You freely gave to me
That’s how I know how to harness
Every gift You have given to me
